Task Key: # Optional (this row and the next are a guide: leave them in or delete them)
# Text: Leave empty to add a new task; a task key (e.g. RWCA-12) updates that task
Sub-workspace: Text: The sub-workspace's name exactly as it shows in the app
Accountant: Person: Email address, or the name as it shows in the app
Project Key: Text: A project of that sub-workspace (e.g. RWCA); empty: the sub-workspace's own task list
Status: Stage: To Start, In Progress, Waiting for Info, Sent to Client, Internal Adjustments, Client Adjustments, Complete or To be Archived; empty: To Start
Priority: Choice: Highest, High, Medium, Low or Lowest; empty: Medium
Team Lead: Person: Email address, or the name as it shows in the app
Reviewer: Person: Email address, or the name as it shows in the app
Currently Responsible: Person: Email address, or the name; empty: the accountant
Start Date: Date: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-11-02) or DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 02/11/2026); empty: today
Due Date: Date: YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY; empty: 5 days after the start date
Estimated Hours: Number: Hours, a point for decimals (e.g. 6.5); 0 to 10000
Budgeted Hours: Number: Hours, a point for decimals (e.g. 8); set by a team lead or above
Labels: List: The project's existing labels, separated by ; (e.g. GST; Urgent)
Add Standard Sub-tasks: Yes/No: yes adds Pre-check, Preparation, Internal Review and Client Review; empty: no
